title: imap: AUTH=LOGIN authentication handler
description: Add AUTH=LOGIN to crates/imap/src/commands/auth.rs. SASL LOGIN is a two-step challenge: (1) receive CommandAuthenticateReceived(LOGIN, None); (2) server.authenticate_continue(base64('Username:')); (3) receive AuthenticateDataReceived(username_b64); (4) server.authenticate_continue(base64('Password:')); (5) receive AuthenticateDataReceived(password_b64); (6) decode both, call credential_store.check; (7) authenticate_finish(ok or no). Maintain LOGIN state (waiting_for_username vs waiting_for_password) inside the session dispatch loop per-connection. Defensive: decode errors -> bad; AuthenticateData::Cancel -> no.
